questions.title: Which U.S. state will have the highest reported cyclospora case count by July 16, 2026?
questions.background: Cyclospora is a parasite that causes intestinal illness. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) monitors reported infections across U.S. states.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The latest CDC state-level data publicly available on July 16, 2026, reporting the cumulative number of cyclospora infections reported during 2026
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-16
  • Accepted Answer Format: String (name of the U.S. state)

questions.title: With which country will the United States record its largest trade deficit in May 2026?
questions.background: The United States publishes monthly trade data, including trade balances with its major trading partners.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve using the country-level trade balances in the initial May 2026 trade report from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau. Identify the individual country associated with the largest U.S. trade deficit, excluding regional groupings.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-07
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: What principal criminal penalty will Hannah Dugan receive at her initial sentencing for obstructing a federal proceeding?
questions.background: A federal jury convicted Wisconsin judge Hannah Dugan of obstructing a federal proceeding in December 2025. The case concerned her response to immigration agents seeking to arrest a defendant at her courthouse.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The federal court’s sentencing judgment or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the sentence announced in court.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve when the federal district court first imposes a sentence for Dugan’s obstruction conviction. Identify the principal criminal penalty imposed at that sentencing. Subsequent appeals or resentencing do not change the answer.
  • Accepted Answer Format: A short noun phrase naming the principal criminal penalty.
questions.accepted_format: A short noun phrase naming the principal criminal penalty.

questions.title: Which U.S. state will be the first to impose a statewide moratorium on construction of large new hyperscale data centres?
questions.background: Hyperscale data centres are large facilities designed to provide computing and storage capacity at massive scale. Their development can place substantial demands on electricity grids and water supplies.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Qualifying Event: Resolve to the first U.S. state to formally impose, by December 31, 2026, a statewide temporary moratorium on construction or permitting of large new hyperscale data centres. Proposed legislation, vetoed measures, and restrictions limited to individual municipalities do not qualify.
  • Source of Truth: Official state-government announcements, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution occurs when the qualifying moratorium is publicly announced as imposed.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the state.

questions.title: Which country will the Trump administration target in its first invocation of Section 338 tariff powers by August 18, 2026?
questions.background: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes U.S. tariffs in response to discriminatory treatment of American commerce.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country whose exports are targeted by the Trump administration's first invocation of Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, announced on or before August 18, 2026. An announced tariff measure counts even if its effective date has not yet arrived. Use official U.S. announcements or contemporaneous reporting confirming the invocation.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-18
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: Which Federal Reserve policymakers will vote for an interest-rate increase at the July 29, 2026 FOMC meeting?
questions.background: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets US monetary policy. Its policy announcements disclose members' votes and the policy preferences of dissenting voters.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Federal Reserve's official policy statement and voting record for the meeting concluding July 29, 2026, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution: Identify every voting member whose recorded position favors increasing the federal funds target range relative to the range immediately before the meeting. Include those members whether an increase is adopted or they dissent in favor of one.
  • Accepted Answer Format: All qualifying members' surnames, listed alphabetically and separated by commas.
questions.accepted_format: All qualifying members' surnames, listed alphabetically and separated by commas.

questions.title: Which month of 2026 will have the highest ICE arrest total in the data publicly available by August 26, 2026?
questions.background: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) carries out arrests as part of federal immigration enforcement.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Use government data supplied by ICE, as reported by The Associated Press.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve to the calendar month of 2026 with the largest arrest total among the months covered by the latest ICE monthly figures publicly available by August 26, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the month name only.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the month name only.

questions.title: Which major US employment sector will shed the most jobs in July 2026?
questions.background: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reports monthly changes in nonfarm payroll employment by sector.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the broad employment sector with the largest net decline in payroll jobs in July 2026, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics' initial employment report for that month, released in August 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-07
  • Accepted Answer Format: Compare sectors by the number of jobs lost, not percentage changes, and count subsectors within their parent sectors. Answer with the sector's name.
questions.accepted_format: Compare sectors by the number of jobs lost, not percentage changes, and count subsectors within their parent sectors. Answer with the sector's name.
